problem.symptom: about every second vkm-corpus MCP call from the workstation timed out; the server logged no tool call for them, the API answered in 5-50 ms

reproduction_from_workstation.one_keep_alive_connection_7s_pauses: 3 of 6 calls timed out after 20 s: every call after an idle connection

problem.diagnosis: uvicorn closes an idle keep-alive connection after 5 s. The FIN reaches a client in the mcp container, on the CORE host (published port and container bridge), on EDGE and in WSL on the workstation 5 s after the answer, but never reaches a native Windows process on the workstation: its socket shows the state Bound in the Windows TCP table, so a local connection proxy sits in between. The next request on the pooled connection hangs until the client times out.

fix.code: src/vkm_corpus/mcp/http.py: BearerMiddleware wraps send; every http.response.start carries connection: close (an upstream Connection header is replaced)
